buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK OPEN TENDER FOR EMERGENCY PICK-UP FACILITY AT BPCL MADURAI LPG PLANT 1. The contractor shall provide a dedicated air-conditioned car (1000 cc to 1200 cc or equivalent model) w ith minimum boot space of 350 litres, along with a driver, for official and emergency pick-up/drop requ irements at Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL), Madurai LPG Plant. The vehicle shall not be older than two years, subject to the approved tender conditions. 2. The vehicle and drivers shall be available for up to 16 hours per day and 30 days per month, with an as sured running of 1,500 km per month, as indicated in the Madurai cost estimate. Duty timings and rep orting requirements shall be as directed by the authorised BPCL officer based on operational and emer gency requirements. 3. In addition to the assured running of 1,500 km per month, additional running of up to 300 km per mont h may be required as and when called for, based on official/emergency requirements. Payment for add itional running shall be as per the accepted Schedule of Rates and tender conditions. 4. The vehicle shall be maintained in clean, safe and excellent roadworthy condition, with good-quality up holstery and all legally required safety equipment. The contractor shall ensure that the vehicle remain s fit for immediate deployment when required. 5. The vehicle shall be commercially registered. Registration shall be in the name of the proprietor/proprie tary firm, partner/partnership firm, or company, as applicable, and shall comply with applicable transp ort rules. Personal-use/private registration shall not be accepted. 6. The successful bidder shall provide the Registration Certificate, tax/permit documents, insurance and ot her vehicle records as required by BPCL, within the time specified in the tender. An undertaking on th e bidder’s letterhead shall be submitted with the tender where required.

7. If the vehicle is seized, detained or impounded by the police/transport authority during the contract peri od for any reason attributable to the contractor or vehicle, the risk and responsibility shall rest with th e successful bidder, without disruption to the required service. 8. The vehicle shall have valid comprehensive insurance, including passenger cover as applicable, along w ith valid fitness certificate, permit, pollution certificate and other statutory documents. BPCL shall not be responsible for damage to the vehicle, driver or third parties. 9. In case of breakdown, delay or unavailability, the successful bidder shall promptly deploy a suitable repl acement vehicle at no additional cost. If the bidder fails to do so, BPCL may make alternate arrangem ents at the risk and cost of the successful bidder, subject to the tender conditions. 10. No charges shall be payable for a trip/service not provided as required. Penalties or recoveries for defi cient service, delay or failure to provide a vehicle shall be governed by the approved tender’s Special Terms and Conditions. 11. BPCL reserves the right to impose penalties for deficiency of service under the contract in accordance with the applicable clauses of the tender document. 12. The contractor shall submit GST-compliant tax invoices in the prescribed format with each bill, showin g GST details as per applicable Government regulations. Bills shall be verified against trip records, dut y slips and/or log sheets maintained for the vehicle. 13. The bidder shall account for fuel, driver-related expenses, maintenance, insurance, tolls and other ope rating expenses in the quoted rates. Separate reimbursement or escalation shall be allowed only wher e expressly provided in the approved tender conditions. 14. The driver or contractor’s personnel shall not demand or collect cash or any other payment from BPCL officials, employees, guests or other persons using the vehicle. 15. In addition to the regular vehicle, a Toyota Innova Crysta or equivalent air-conditioned vehicle with dri ver shall be provided on an as-and-when-required basis for official/emergency pick-up, drop and other authorised official movements. Charges shall be as per the accepted Schedule of Rates and tender co nditions. 16. The above requirements shall be read together with the approved Scope of Work, Schedule of Rates, S pecial Terms and Conditions and General Terms and Conditions. Any requirement not specifically listed but necessary to perform the contracted service shall be handled in accordance with the tender condit ions. Note: 1. The service is intended to support official and emergency pick-up/drop requirements at BPCL Madurai LPG Plant. Vehicle deployment, reporting time and destination shall be as directed by the authorise d BPCL officer. 2. The vehicle may be used for BPCL officials, employees, guests and other authorised persons for offici al purposes connected with the plant. 3. The vehicle availability, assured monthly running, additional kilometer limit, on-call vehicle requireme nt and applicable rates shall be as per the final approved tender and Schedule of Rates. For any clarification, bidders can contact Mr. Vishnu MR, HSSE officer and Mr. Sandeep Mishra, Plant Mana ger of BPCL Madurai LPG Plant – Ph No. 9746904046 / 9917714154 between 9.00 to 17.30 hrs. On all worki ng days excepts Sunday/holiday. CERTIFICATE: I/We have understood all the above terms and conditions and I/we accept the same fully.
